configured-discovery.label: Configured discovery source
configured-discovery.description: Pinned candidate-discovery input used by selectors, not enough by itself for broad vocabulary-universe claims.

support-dictionary.label: Dictionary support
support-dictionary.description: Dictionary source for exact written-reading identity and meaning support.

support-commonness.label: Commonness support
support-commonness.description: Commonness or priority support for usefulness; not JLPT level truth.

registered-future.label: Registered future source
registered-future.description: Source family registered for future review; no active evidence contribution.

jlptstudy-community-list.label: JLPTStudy community vocabulary lists
jlptstudy-community-list.description: Public community JLPT vocabulary lists; configured discovery only until license/source-origin review is complete.

tanos-vocab-list.label: Tanos vocabulary lists
tanos-vocab-list.description: Tanos JLPT vocabulary lists; useful discovery signal but not a complete post-2010 official JLPT universe.

jlptsensei-web-list.label: JLPT Sensei vocabulary lists
jlptsensei-web-list.description: Public JLPT Sensei vocabulary pages; registered as blocked because the terms forbid republishing, copying, and redistribution.

edrdg-jmdict.label: EDRDG JMdict
edrdg-jmdict.description: JMdict dictionary and priority markers for identity/commonness support, not JLPT level truth.

future-textbook-word-list.label: Future textbook word-list review
future-textbook-word-list.description: Placeholder for Japanese-published or permissioned learner sources reviewed through exact source-access packets.

blocked-frequency.label: Blocked frequency source
blocked-frequency.description: Frequency source blocked or unavailable for governed use.

jlptsensei.label: JLPT Sensei
jlptsensei.description: Single JLPT Sensei source family; blocked until written permission or compatible terms exist.

future-textbook.label: Future textbook source family
future-textbook.description: Reserved for individually reviewed Japanese-published or permissioned learner sources.

configured_source_only.releaseMeaning: Only the configured pinned source list has been evaluated; this is not a broad vocabulary-universe claim.

candidate_discovery_governed.releaseMeaning: At least one governed candidate-discovery assignment exists, but source-depth is incomplete.

single_source_family.releaseMeaning: Reviewed evidence comes from one independent source family only.

multi_source_supported.releaseMeaning: Multiple independent source signals exist, but full source-depth policy is not met.

level_universe_standard.releaseMeaning: This identity meets the configured broad word-source universe standard.

source_access_gap.releaseMeaning: A source may exist, but exact permitted access/evidence is missing.

source_origin_not_evaluated.releaseMeaning: No reviewed source-origin assignment exists for this word identity.

disputed_level_claim.releaseMeaning: Reviewed source level claims are tied or conflicting.

jlptstudy.net-n5.name: JLPTStudy N5 vocabulary list
jlptstudy.net-n5.notes: Configured selector input only. Do not claim broad N5 vocabulary-universe adequacy from this source family.

jlptstudy.net-n4.name: JLPTStudy N4 vocabulary list
jlptstudy.net-n4.notes: Configured selector input only. Do not claim broad N4 vocabulary-universe adequacy from this source family.

tanos-n5-vocab.name: Tanos JLPT N5 vocabulary list
tanos-n5-vocab.notes: Permitted CC BY Tanos N5 Mnemosyne source normalized through reviewed source-access/input workflow. Single-family evidence only; not broad N5 vocabulary-universe adequacy.

tanos-n4-vocab.name: Tanos JLPT N4 vocabulary list
tanos-n4-vocab.notes: Permitted CC BY Tanos N4 Mnemosyne source normalized through reviewed source-access/input workflow. Single-family evidence only; not broad N4 vocabulary-universe adequacy.

tanos-n3-vocab.name: Tanos JLPT N3 vocabulary list
tanos-n3-vocab.notes: Configured selector input; source-depth still requires independent corroboration before broad N3 claims.

jlptsensei-vocabulary.name: JLPT Sensei vocabulary pages
jlptsensei-vocabulary.notes: Rejected for stored source assignments: terms reserve all rights and prohibit republishing, reproducing, duplicating, copying, and redistributing site material. Keep as blocked unless written permission or compatible terms are obtained.
